hints: First divide by $5$ and exponentiate to remove the natural logarithm.
Isolate $3^x$ from $4-3^x=e^{6/5}$ and check that the resulting value is positive.
Take logarithms to solve $3^x=4-e^{6/5}$, then round the final value to 3 decimal places.
walkthrough:
Calculate the numerical value of the right-hand side:
$$\mathrm{e}^{1.2} \approx 3.320117$$
$$3^x \approx 4 - 3.320117 = 0.679883$$

Take the natural logarithm of both sides:
$$\ln(3^x) = \ln(0.679883)$$
$$x\ln 3 = \ln(0.679883)$$
